summary: Tested Marca Rise app (Vite/React/TS frontend + FastAPI backend). Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass — POST /api/contact returns 200 with valid payload, validates 422 on bad input, persists to MongoDB contact_submissions. Frontend: home, navbar, BookACallWidget, services list with new titles, 6 unique service detail pages, 404 page, contact form (empty validation + valid submission with success state), and founders SAM/SANJAY all verified. Resend integration returns real 200 success.

minor.issue: Logger reference `logger.exception` (line 129) defined at module bottom (line 170). Works due to module-level evaluation but is brittle — should declare logger before its first use.

issues: React hydration warning: nested <a> inside <a> (wouter <Link> wraps children with <a>, but Notfound's CTA is also an <a> with data-testid='notfound-home-btn'). Replace inner <a> with <span> or <div> inside <Link>.

action_items: Fix nested <a> tag in Notfound.tsx: change inner <a data-testid='notfound-home-btn'> to <span> or <div> since wouter <Link> already renders an <a>.
Minor: declare `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` near top of server.py before its first usage in `submit_contact` exception handler.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `logger` is used inside `submit_contact` before its module-level definition (line 170). Move logger init right after imports.

server.py: `_id` is excluded from /api/status via projection but contact_submissions also gets `_id`; current /api/contact endpoint only returns `{status, id}` so it's safe, but any future GET /api/contact should exclude _id.
Contact.tsx: Form validation, error states, loading state and success state all correctly implemented with data-testid.
BookACallWidget: Correctly uses target=_blank with rel=noreferrer, fixed bottom-right, z-60.
App.tsx: Both /contact and /Contact (capital C) routes registered for backward compat — good.
Notfound.tsx: nested anchor tags cause React warning; non-blocking but should be fixed.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test contact submissions (TEST_QA Bot, TEST_FE QA, direct@example.com) — all cleaned up post-test from contact_submissions collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend POST /api/contact works end-to-end with Resend live API (re_jMFSYc1m_...). Resend sandbox sender 'onboarding@resend.dev' delivers to verified RESEND_TO_EMAIL (sam.marcarise@gmail.com). All 6 service detail pages have unique hero headings, checklists, and Why-Choose-Us cards. The Notfound page has a minor React DOM nesting warning that doesn't break functionality.
